instruction: Export all my Simple Note notes to "~/backups/simple_note/" directory in my file system. The files should be named according to the note title, replacing white space with "_", and the extension should be ".md".
notes: The number of notes is unknown before simple_note.search_notes runs, so the problem uses three placeholder notes (note-1..note-3); at runtime the chain (next-note ...) is instantiated with one note object per note returned by search_notes (all pages). Because quantified goals are not allowed, 'all notes exported' is encoded with an ordered chain and an export cursor: file-system-create-file for a note requires the cursor to be on that note and moves it to the next marker; the domain constant end-of-notes marks the end of the chain, so (export-cursor end-of-notes) holds exactly when every note has been written. Each note's target path is a static mapping (backup-file-of) computed from the title (whitespace -> '_', '.md' extension, under ~/backups/simple_note/); its content is revealed by simple_note.show_note (content-known) and written via file_system.create_file, which also creates the parent directory implicitly (no create_directory call, matching the reference). search_notes is modeled with only access_token; pagination (page_index) is handled at runtime. supervisor.show_profile provides the email used as username for both logins. supervisor.complete_task is called without an answer and is forced last via (task-completed).
